title: Where is Ava?
description: Help Ava find out what happened to her human body.

objectives.title: Talk to Rosco Foreman
objectives.description: Speak to Rosco Foreman, a cartographer who might have more information about the Old Network.

objectives.title: Meet Gan Coilson Again
objectives.description: Talk to Gan Coilson about his human past.

objectives.title: Investigate the TheraPay Bots
objectives.description: Ask a TheraPay Bot about possible human Automatas.

objectives.title: Find the sentient Vacuum Cleaner
objectives.description: Find the sentient Vacuum Cleaner at Meridian Market and talk about his human past.

objectives.title: Talk to Banor about Ava
objectives.description: Talk to Banor about Ava's human traits.

objectives.title: Ask Huckstash about the Old Network
objectives.description: Huckstash might know something about the Old Network.

objectives.title: Talk to Gunger about books
objectives.description: Gunger may know something about Ava's past.

objectives.title: Investigate Cryogenics
objectives.description: Alan Fontus is a scientist. He may know something about Ava's past.

objectives.title: Ask Dr Fred about Ava's pain
objectives.description: Dr. Fred might know a thing or two about pain.

objectives.title: Ask RM Alken about Ava's pain
objectives.description: RM Alken is a doctor and might know a thing or two about pain.

objectives.title: Interview Dr Alken about Ava's pain
objectives.description: RM Alken is a doctor and might know a thing or two about pain.

objectives.title: Discuss the Leech Worm parasite with a historian
objectives.description: Ask historian Al-Zahiri about the history of the Leech Worm parasite.

objectives.title: Look for JR Amiga
objectives.description: JR Amiga writes memories for humans. Maybe she knows this could be done with Automatas?

objectives.title: The ballad of Hepzibah Gimble
objectives.description: Hepzibah Gimble knows what happened to the coma roamers.

objectives.title: Can Nabla help?
objectives.description: Find Nabla, who might be able to do some risky research.

objectives.title: Hire Nabla
objectives.description: Pay Nabla for the risks he takes. Have 1000 Lims ready.

objectives.title: Meet McFellow at Metro Hub during Curfew
objectives.description: Steven McFellow at Metro Hub will lead you to Nabla, but only during curfew.

objectives.title: Meet Alexander at Skyhigh Gardens during Curfew
objectives.description: McFellow sent you to Alexander at the Skyhigh Gardens, who might lead you to Nabla during curfew.

objectives.title: Meet Rollo in the Spire during Curfew
objectives.description: Alexander sent you to Rollo in the Spire who might lead you to Nabla. But only in the shadow of the night during curfew.

objectives.title: Meet Nabla during Curfew
objectives.description: Nabla expects you to visit during curfew to share what he found out.

objectives.title: Confront Hepzibah Gimble
objectives.description: It's time to confront Hepzibah about the whole story.

objectives.title: Ask Rosetta for Help
objectives.description: Maybe Rosetta can give you access to records that might reveal the location of Ava's body.

objectives.title: Talk to the old TheraPay Bot
objectives.description: There's a very old and mad TheraPay bot. And maybe it will slip some long hidden information.

objectives.title: Gan Coilson could help
objectives.description: Gan Coilson might be the only one who still knows something about the Old Network's terminal password protection.

objectives.title: Ask Kai Galosh about the Old Network
objectives.description: Kai Galosh promised to tell you a thing or two about the Old Network.

objectives.title: The End?
objectives.description: Unlock Ava's crypt and give her a choice about her future.

objectives.title: Ceres Coilson could help
objectives.description: Ceres Coilson might be the only one to help with the Old Network's terminal password protection. She still has access to her husband's construct.

objectives.title: Talk to Ceres Coilson
objectives.description: Talk to Ceres Coilson about Gan's human past.

objectives.title: Celebrate with Banor
objectives.description: Ask Banor about a possible code to enter the secret room in Egress.

objectives.title: Talk to Huckstash
objectives.description: Ask Huckstash about a possible code to enter the secret room in Egress.

objectives.title: Party with Alan Fontus
objectives.description: Ask Alan Fontus about a possible code to enter the secret room in Egress.

objectives.title: Meet Gunger Hahn
objectives.description: Ask Gunger Hahn about a possible code to enter the secret room in Egress.

objectives.title: Wait for Ava's Research
objectives.description: Discuss what you know with Ava.

objectives.title: Investigate the Book Fair during Curfew
objectives.description: There's a secret book fair in the Sewers after curfew. Maybe you will find some information there.

objectives.title: Find the Blackbox for Kai during Curfew
objectives.description: Fish for the sunken black box for Kai Galosh during curfew.

objectives.title: Find the Cryo Chamber
objectives.description: Find the cryo chamber where Ava's body is supposed to be, inside Egress.

objectives.title: Find more Clues
objectives.description: Learn more about the inhabitants within the LUZ.

objectives.title: Locate the Terminal
objectives.description: Locate the Old Network interface.

objectives.title: Unlock the Terminal
objectives.description: Use the code to access the Old Network terminal room.
